title: KUT — Revit smoke-test checklist
intro:
Ordered manual checklist for the BIM Manager's first Revit session on the Kampala Uganda Temple pack. Every command below builds clean and its wiring is machine-checked (`python tools/check_smoke_test.py`), but **none of it has been exercised against a real model** — walk this list on a sample KUT model before the engagement relies on it.

Steps marked **pre-cleared offline** have had their contract asserted by the CI gate: the command tag resolves, the button is really on the declared panel/tab/section with that label, the fixture exists, and the parameters named in the expected outcome are registered and bound. A failure on one of those in Revit is a genuine surprise, not a stale checklist.

What the gate cannot prove is everything about real geometry — whether the tags are *right*, whether an LOD verdict is *fair*, whether the mis-placed switch is actually caught. That judgement is what this session is for.
outro:
Log any failure with the command, the `StingTools.log` excerpt, and the model context.

**This file is generated.** Edit `docs/examples/KUT/smoke_test.json` and run `python tools/build_smoke_test.py`; `tools/check_smoke_test.py` fails CI if the two disagree. See [`docs/examples/_smoke_test_schema.md`](../_smoke_test_schema.md).

steps.title: Deploy the build and open a KUT model with rooms placed
steps.expected: STING dock panel loads; no startup errors in StingTools.log
steps.notes: DLL + data/ + StingTools.addin, Revit 2025. Confirm where Revit actually loads from — grep the live .addin's <Assembly> path; copying into a folder the manifest does not name fails silently.

steps.title: Copy the whole KUT overlay pack into <project>/_BIM_COORD/
steps.expected: All seven overlay files in place: manifest.json, project_config.json, tag_schemes.json, lod_matrix.json, owner_standards.json, fohlio_map.json, sting_classification.json (+ climate_data.json only if the corporate Kampala entry is being replaced)
steps.notes: Copy the FOLDER, not a selection. This step used to name three files from docs/examples/KUT/, so owner_standards.json, lod_matrix.json and fohlio_map.json never arrived and steps 12, 13 and 17-19 silently exercised the corporate baseline. Then on Project Information set PRJ_ORG_PROJECT_CODE_TXT = KUT, the originator code, an address containing "Kampala", and PLM_PRJ_PLUMBING_CODE_TXT = IPC-US (blank falls back to BS EN 12056 with no error).

steps.title: Load Params
steps.expected: Binds without error. In Manage → Shared Parameters confirm ASS_TAG_SCHEME_TXT, ASS_LOD_VERIFIED_TXT, CSI_SECTION_TXT, CSI_TITLE_TXT and FOHLIO_REF_TXT are bound to all categories, and that LTG_HOIST_WEIGHT_KG, LTG_HOIST_MOTOR_TXT and LTG_HOIST_DROP_MM are bound to Lighting Fixtures ONLY — not Generic Models
steps.notes: The Lighting-Fixtures-only scope is the correct one: PARAMETER_REGISTRY.json declares binding "LightingFixtures" and RESOLVED_BINDINGS.csv (the domain-derived source of truth SharedParamGuids reads) lists Lighting Fixtures alone. The sibling LTG_FIX_* params are "universal" and DO also reach Generic Models — do not use them as the pattern. Step 27 is the live test of this binding.

steps.title: Scheme Inspect
steps.expected: kut-temple-example shows ● enabled and valid

steps.title: Batch Tag a sample area
steps.expected: Elements get ASS_TAG_1_TXT; new tags get a scheme string in ASS_TAG_SCHEME_TXT automatically

steps.title: Render Scheme
steps.expected: Back-fills ASS_TAG_SCHEME_TXT on already-tagged elements; the render stamp updates

steps.title: Scheme Audit
steps.expected: 0 mismatches after the render

steps.title: Token Confidence audit
steps.expected: High/Medium/Low bands plus a silent-BLD1 count; ASS_LOC_SOURCE_TXT and ASS_ZONE_SOURCE_TXT populated
steps.notes: Confirm a site element inside a STING-LOC::BLD2 scope box reads LOC_SOURCE=ScopeBox (High). Draw STING-LOC scope boxes UNROTATED — STING stores axis-aligned plan extents, so a rotated box is treated as its larger envelope. Where boxes nest, the smallest containing box wins.

steps.title: LOD Verify at Deliverable B
steps.expected: TaskDialog states LOD 300; CSV STING_LOD_deliverable-b_Audit.csv and a JSON gate report in _BIM_COORD/lod_reports/
steps.notes: Check the SKIPPED line. If it reports elements skipped for having no category rule and no "*" fallback, those are outside the denominator — a coverage gap, not a pass. A run with nothing in scope now says "NO ELEMENTS IN SCOPE", never 100%.

steps.title: LOD Verify at Construction (LOD 400)
steps.expected: Pick "Construction stage (fabrication/installation)"; the report states LOD 400. Plumbing Fixtures require MNT_TYPE_TXT at this rung
steps.notes: The construction milestone at LOD 400 was inserted by #623 and no step has ever exercised it. The MNT_TYPE_TXT requirement is new to KUT: the project lod_matrix.json overlay used to restate the Plumbing Fixtures rule minus that line, which silently relaxed the gate; the overlay no longer pins any category.

steps.title: LOD Verify at Deliverable D (LOD 500)
steps.expected: Pick "Deliverable D (record / as-built model)"; the report states LOD 500. Serialised plant requires ASS_SERIAL_NR_TXT and ASS_INSTALLATION_DATE_TXT; fabric and distribution categories inherit 400 and add nothing
steps.notes: Deliverable D moved 400 → 500 in #623 and rung 500 was made category-dependent in #635. This is the newest, least-exercised data in the pack — expect fabric to pass and serialised plant to fail on an early model, and confirm that asymmetry rather than a blanket failure.

steps.title: LOD Stamp at Deliverable B
steps.expected: Passing elements get ASS_LOD_VERIFIED_TXT = deliverable-b. This is the only LOD command that writes, and it writes exactly this one parameter

steps.title: Program Audit against the A1 brief
steps.expected: Compliant / over / under / missing / extra summary; XLSX with a Status column

steps.title: Owner Standards audit
steps.expected: RAG summary; CSV + JSON in _BIM_COORD/owner_standards_reports/. The KUT sheet-number rule, the narrowed discipline taxonomy and the ffe-fohlio-ref check (WARN, non-blocking) must all appear — if they do not, the overlay from step 2 did not arrive

steps.title: Device coordination audit
steps.expected: Per-room findings; CSV. Sanity-check that a deliberately mis-placed switch behind a door swing is flagged

steps.title: CSI Assign — fill empty only
steps.expected: CSI_SECTION_TXT and CSI_TITLE_TXT written; unmapped-category list reported
steps.notes: CSI_Assign cannot classify demolition — CsiMasterFormat.Resolve never sees Phase Demolished, so Division 02 stays empty. Assign it by hand BEFORE step 17, or the Owner's Division 02 spec sections report as over-specification and the reconciliation reads clean when it is not.

steps.title: SpecLink Reconcile
steps.expected: Spec-gap / over-spec / title-mismatch counts; XLSX report

steps.title: Fohlio Export
steps.expected: FF&E CSV with the columns declared in _BIM_COORD/fohlio_map.json

steps.title: Fohlio Import
steps.expected: Preview/diff dialog before any write; on Apply, FOHLIO_REF_TXT and the mapped fields are written and an ES snapshot is stored
steps.notes: Re-pick the CSV from step 18, or an edited copy carrying a Fohlio Ref column.

steps.title: Fohlio Audit
steps.expected: Linked % plus missing-ref and stale counts per category. Edit a model value and re-run — that row must read stale

steps.title: Review Comments import (Bluebeam)
steps.expected: Upserts into _BIM_COORD/review_comments.json against gate "Deliverable B"; close-out rate shown

steps.title: Review dashboard, then KPI export
steps.expected: Grid of comments; then "KPI Export" writes a CSV with per-gate close-out %

steps.title: ComCheck export
steps.expected: Per-space CSV with an allowed-vs-proposed summary; the dialog states the paste-into-COMcheck workflow
steps.notes: On the ELECTRICAL panel, not the main one. Its buttons were ungated by the wiring check until Tier 4 was widened to all six panels.

steps.title: HVAC life-cycle cost comparison
steps.expected: Year-by-year XLSX (Summary + per-option sheets, nominal + NPV); crossover year reported

steps.title: Prototype drift report
steps.expected: Type-level diff XLSX grouped by discipline
steps.notes: Needs the Owner's prototype model, loaded as a link or opened, then picked.

steps.title: ACC pull clashes
steps.expected: Model Coordination clashes pulled and ranked; CSV written; top-ranked escalated to ACC Issues idempotently via the _BIM_COORD/acc/pushed_clashes.json sidecar
steps.notes: Needs %APPDATA%/Planscape/acc_credentials.json. Endpoint paths are verified against the public APS sample but not against a live tenant — this is the live pull to do during mobilisation. The command existed and was step 3 of the Coordination Cycle preset, but had no button of its own until now.

steps.title: Create the MEP Lighting Schedule
steps.expected: The Hoist Load (kg) / Hoist Motor / Hoist Drop (mm) columns appear, driven by LTG_HOIST_WEIGHT_KG, LTG_HOIST_MOTOR_TXT and LTG_HOIST_DROP_MM
steps.notes: Revit-native schedule creation from the STING schedule definitions (MR_SCHEDULES.csv row "Lighting Schedule"). This is the live test of step 3's binding claim: the columns can only appear because those three parameters bind to Lighting Fixtures.

steps.title: Build Seeds on a scratch project
steps.expected: All 16 seed families build. In STING_SEED_PlumbingFixture, the STING_SEED_BaptismalFont symbol builds with DCW + DHW supply, a SAN drain, and a recirculation supply/return pair carrying the DomesticHot systemType
steps.notes: There is no STING_SEED_BaptismalFont.json — the font is a symbol INSIDE Data/Seeds/STING_SEED_PlumbingFixture.json (Phase 192 E4). The old checklist also told you to press a "Build Seeds" button that did not exist: Seeds_Build was reachable only from inside WORKFLOW_{PenetrationSweep, PenetrationRegister, PlumbingRoughIn, ElectricalRoughIn, SLDProduction}. The button now exists, which is why this step reads "button" and not "workflow".

steps.title: KUT Gate Audit — the read-only pre-gate check
steps.expected: Eight steps chain without an unknown-tag error: PreTagAudit → TokenConfidenceAudit → OwnerStandards_Audit → Program_Audit → DeviceCoord_Audit → LOD_Verify → ExportModelHealth → FullComplianceDashboard. NOTHING is written to the model
steps.notes: Replaces the old step that ran WORKFLOW_GateAudit.json, which has been deleted: it contained ValidateTags and CompletenessDashboard, both [Transaction(TransactionMode.Manual)] writers that build legends, so it was not the read-only check its description claimed. The checker now proves the read-only claim for every preset that makes it.

steps.title: KUT Deliverable A gate (LOD 200)
steps.expected: The A gate runs end to end: tokens, tags, program audit; LOD verification at deliverable-a
steps.notes: The three Deliverable gate presets (#638) had no smoke-test coverage at all before this.

steps.title: KUT Deliverable B gate (LOD 300)
steps.expected: The fullest gate runs: program + owner-standards + CSI + device coordination + Fohlio finishes + clash, then LOD verification at deliverable-b
steps.notes: Confirm CSI_Assign runs BEFORE SpecLink_Reconcile — reversed, every spec section reports as a gap and the report is worthless.

steps.title: KUT Deliverable C gate (LOD 350)
steps.expected: Adds CSI → SpecLink reconcile and the sheet register for the bidding set; LOD verification at deliverable-c

steps.title: Owner KPI dashboard
steps.expected: RAG bars, per-discipline table and clash burn-down; HTML + CSV written; a snapshot appended to _BIM_COORD/kpi/KUT_kpi_log.jsonl
steps.notes: Was KUT_KpiDashboard, which still resolves as an alias. The code comes from PRJ_ORG_PROJECT_CODE_TXT, so with step 2 done the log is KUT_kpi_log.jsonl; an existing kut_kpi_log.jsonl is read and appended to rather than orphaned.
